# masterdaweb_firewall (Data Source)

Looks up a firewall by its id or its name, with its rules in the order they apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "masterdaweb_firewall" "web" {
  name = "web"
}

output "web_rules" {
  value = data.masterdaweb_firewall.web.rules
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The firewall's id. Give the id or the name.
- `name` (String) The firewall's name, which only it has. Give the id or the name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) What it is for.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it filters traffic.
- `has_pending_changes` (Boolean) Whether it has edits not applied yet.
- `instance_ids` (Set of String) The instances it applies to.
- `policy_in` (String) What happens to inbound traffic no rule matches: ACCEPT, DROP or REJECT.
- `policy_out` (String) What happens to outbound traffic no rule matches.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Its rules, in the order they apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) ACCEPT, DROP or REJECT.
- `comment` (String) A note on the rule.
- `dest_port` (String) The destination ports.
- `destination` (String) Where it goes to.
- `direction` (String) in or out.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule applies.
- `macro` (String) A named service, like SSH (masterdaweb_firewall_macros).
- `protocol` (String) tcp, udp, icmp…
- `source` (String) Where the traffic comes from (addresses, networks).
- `source_port` (String) The source ports.
